entries.snippet: The employees protested against the removal of the site's female workers due to a request by a visiting Hindu group. The tower's operating company apologized for the decision.

entries.title: 3 years on, Morocco earthquake victims still wait for help

entries.title: Saxony-Anhalt: Germany wakes up to 'unsettling' AfD victory

entries.snippet: The tit-for-tat reaction comes after Germany said it is shutting down Russia's consulate in Bonn and its cultural center in Berlin.

entries.title: Pakistan: Can creating new provinces fix governance?

entries.title: EU's von der Leyen pledges $232 million Greenland investment

entries.title: Threatening letters revive fears among Kashmiri Pandits

entries.title: Russia opens first road bridge with North Korea

entries.title: India news: Rescue efforts underway in deadly Delhi building collapse

entries.title: Jamaica to petition King Charles over slavery reparations
